main.summary: Exception thrown when a data protection transition commits but its post-commit cleanup fails.
main.remarks: The data protection state has already changed. No automatic retry is performed. If is populated, it identifies the backup file that requires manual cleanup; encryption backups may contain plaintext. The original cleanup error is available as the inner exception.

property.name: Operation
property.summary: Gets the committed data protection method name, such as EncryptData or DecryptData.

property.name: BackupPath
property.summary: Gets the backup file path requiring manual cleanup, or null when no backup path is available.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initializes an exception describing a committed operation whose post-commit cleanup failed.
constructor.param: Backup file path requiring manual cleanup, when available.
